pageProps.content: ## Review While taking a walk nearby after lunch, a place that clearly looked like it served great coffee caught my eye, so I stopped by to grab some takeout. It had already been on my shortlist of nice cafes to visit in Gongju, so I stepped inside without hesitation. The seating inside was quite limited, but since I had planned on getting takeout from the start, it wasn't an issue at all. While waiting after placing my order at the counter, I took a look around, and the interior was charming and beautifully decorated. ```adcard ``` As a side note, it seemed they had run out of ice at the time, as a staff member who appeared to be the owner's daughter rushed over to the convenience store across the street to buy some. Before long, my coffee was served, and the flavor was remarkably rich. In particular, the deep, lingering coffee aroma was totally my style. If there had been seats available and I had plenty of time, it would have been wonderful to sit inside and take my time enjoying it. It is definitely the kind of cafe I'd love to visit again the next time I find myself in Gongju. ## Pictures
